title: What was the position of the circuits during Lewis Hamilton's fastest lap i
question:
What was the position of the circuits during Lewis Hamilton's fastest lap in a Formula_1 race?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: fastest lap refers to MIN(time)

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_004
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
WHERE d.XCL_038 = 'Lewis'
  AND d.XCL_039 = 'Hamilton'
  AND lt.XCL_047 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 ASC
LIMIT 1
